headlines.title_en: Bank stocks were the main source of QFII profits in the third quarter
headlines.summary_en: Wind data shows that as of the end of the third quarter, QFIIs held a total of 1,309 A-shares. Of these, 752 stocks rose in the third quarter, accounting for 57.4%, with an average gain of 5.66%, outperforming the Shanghai Composite Index by 11.82 percentage points and the ChiNext Index by 33.46 percentage points. Among them, 67 stocks rose more than 50% and 25 doubled. Among the QFII-held stocks that rose more than 50% in the third quarter, by SW Level-1 industry classification, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology had the most, at 13 stocks, accounting for 26%, with an average gain of 102%; basic chemicals had 5; home appliances, electronics, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fisheries, and light industry manufacturing each had 4; food and beverage and real estate each had 3. Bank stocks were the main source of QFII profits in the third quarter. headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC tightens misleading titles to reduce investors' risk of misjudgment
headlines.summary_en: On November 6, the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission published consultation conclusions on further restricting the use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors, with the proposed amendments receiving broad market support. The SFC said it will expand the list of restricted titles and establish a mechanism to update the list more quickly, while extending regulatory coverage to the virtual asset sector, thereby reducing investors' misjudgments caused by institution names at the source and reinforcing investor protection.

headlines.title: 商务部回应“美首次以涉古巴为由制裁中企”：敦促美方尽快纠正错误做法
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人就美制裁中国企业答记者问。 问：美东时间11月5日，美国务院宣布制裁两家中国企业。有消息称，这是美首次以涉古巴为由对中国企业实施制裁。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。美方以涉及第三方为由，对中国企业采取单边制裁，违反国际法和国际关系基本准则，中方对此坚决反对。 近期，美方升级对中方制裁打压，密集出台多项歧视性限制措施，严重损害中国企业权益，背离两国元首达成的重要共识，破坏中美经贸关系稳定。中方敦促美方尽快纠正错误做法，并保留采取必要措施、维护自身正当权益的权利。（商务部网站）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce responds to 'US sanctions on Chinese companies over Cuba for the first time': urges the US to correct its wrong practices as soon as possible
headlines.summary_en: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce answered questions on U.S. sanctions against Chinese companies. Q: On November 5 Eastern Time, the U.S. State Department announced sanctions on two Chinese companies. Reports say this is the first time the U.S. has imposed sanctions on Chinese companies over Cuba-related grounds. What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. The U.S. side has imposed unilateral sanctions on Chinese companies on grounds involving a third party, which violates international law and the basic norms of international relations. China firmly opposes this. Recently, the U.S. side has escalated sanctions and suppression against China, intensively introducing multiple discriminatory restrictive measures, seriously harming the rights and interests of Chinese companies, departing from the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, and undermining the stability of China-U.S. economic and trade relations. China urges the U.S. side to correct its erroneous practices as soon as possible, and reserves the right to take necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests. (Ministry of Commerce website)

headlines.title: 公私募密集自购，真金白银传递信心
headlines.summary: 近段时间，公私募机构频繁出手自购，以真金白银传递对中国资本市场长期健康稳定发展的信心。据记者不完全统计，10月公募基金自购金额合计已超过20亿元，主动ETF成为其重要载体。另外，中欧瑞博、凯丰投资等百亿私募也在近期自购旗下权益类产品。在业内人士看来，近期稳市场举措密集落地，与公私募自购形成政策与资金共振，进一步夯实市场内在稳定机制、增强市场韧性与信心。（经济参考报）

headlines.title_en: Public and private funds密集 make concentrated proprietary purchases, conveying confidence with real money
headlines.summary_en: Recently, public and private fund institutions have frequently made self-purchases, using real money to convey confidence in the long-term healthy and stable development of China's capital market. According to an incomplete count by the reporter, public fund self-purchases totaled more than 2 billion yuan in October, with active ETFs becoming an important vehicle. In addition, 10-billion-yuan private funds such as China Europe Ruibo and Capstone Investment also recently purchased their own equity products. Industry insiders believe that the intensive rollout of market-stabilizing measures recently, together with self-purchases by public and private funds, has created a resonance between policy and capital, further consolidating the market's internal stabilization mechanism and enhancing market resilience and confidence. (Economic Information Daily)

headlines.title_en: Credit Agricole: The Canadian dollar remains weighed down by economic weakness; employment data may determine the next direction
headlines.summary_en: A Credit Agricole research report noted that over the past week, USD/CAD stabilized near 1.40. The Democrats' landslide victory after the U.S. midterm elections did not significantly boost the Canadian dollar, and earlier positive signals from the resumption of U.S.-Canada trade negotiations also failed to change the situation. Canada's preliminary third-quarter GDP showed growth slowing to 1.3%, below the Bank of Canada's 2% forecast, with economic weakness continuing to weigh on the Canadian dollar. The bank believes the near-term focus shifts to the October employment report. Previously weak employment data raised market concerns that Canada's labor market may struggle to cope with U.S.-Canada trade friction. If the job market shows signs of recovery, it could provide support for the Canadian dollar. However, for USD/CAD to effectively break below the 200-day moving average near 1.39, stronger positive catalysts are still needed.

headlines.title: 财政扩张遇上货币收紧，加拿大政策组合引发分歧
headlines.summary: 加拿大蒙特利尔银行资本市场首席经济学家道格拉斯·波特在周末发布的报告中表示，加拿大的财政政策与货币政策可能正在朝着相反的方向发力。波特表示，加拿大政府公布的年度预算计划内容比预期更加充实，带来了力度可观的财政刺激。受此影响，该行已将加拿大2027年GDP增长预期从1.8%上调至2%。与此同时，加拿大央行为应对上调后的通胀预期而加息，未来还可能进一步加息。波特表示：“如果这还不算政策方向相互矛盾，那就很难想象什么情况才算政策冲突。”此外，他指出，就业数据疲软、油价回落以及科技股抛售，可能促使加拿大央行决策者重新评估是否有必要在12月再次加息。

headlines.title_en: Fiscal expansion meets monetary tightening, Canada's policy mix sparks disagreement
headlines.summary_en: Douglas Porter, chief economist at BMO Capital Markets, said in a report released over the weekend that Canada's fiscal and monetary policies may be pulling in opposite directions. Porter said the annual budget plan unveiled by the Canadian government was more substantial than expected, delivering considerable fiscal stimulus. As a result, the bank has raised its 2027 GDP growth forecast for Canada from 1.8% to 2%. At the same time, the Bank of Canada is raising interest rates in response to upgraded inflation expectations and may raise them further in the future. Porter said: "If that is not contradictory policy direction, it is hard to imagine what is." He also noted that weak employment data, falling oil prices and the tech stock selloff may prompt Bank of Canada policymakers to reassess whether another rate hike in December is necessary.

headlines.title: 中白工业园铁路场站正式投运
headlines.summary: 位于白俄罗斯明斯克郊区的中白工业园GREATPORT多式联运铁路场站6日正式开业投运，首列“麦穗”号和“矢车菊”号中欧集装箱班列从场站发往中国。GREATPORT是现代化物流综合体，该项目由中白工业园居民企业亚欧陆运通道股份有限公司投资运营，具备集装箱班列集结、发运和接收能力，可处理进出口及过境等货流任务。场站设计年吞吐量为18万标箱，未来计划提升至50万标箱。项目已建成4条铁路线及系列配套功能设施。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: The railway terminal of the China-Belarus Industrial Park is officially put into operation
headlines.summary_en: The GREATPORT multimodal railway terminal in the China-Belarus Great Stone Industrial Park on the outskirts of Minsk, Belarus, officially opened and began operations on the 6th, with the first China-Europe container trains "Maishui" and "Shicheju" departing from the terminal for China. GREATPORT is a modern logistics complex invested in and operated by Eurasia Land Transport Corridor Co., Ltd., a resident enterprise of the Great Stone Industrial Park. It has the capacity to assemble, dispatch and receive container trains and can handle import, export and transit cargo flows. The terminal is designed with an annual throughput of 180,000 TEUs, with plans to raise it to 500,000 TEUs in the future. The project has completed four railway lines and a series of supporting facilities. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 前三季度广告业头部企事业单位收入同比增长8.5%
headlines.summary: 据市说新语公众号，数据显示，前三季度全国从事广告业务的头部企事业单位共实现收入16008.3亿元，同比增长8.5%。前三季度，互联网广告收入9568.9亿元，同比增长17.5%，其中，移动互联网广告发布收入8125亿元，同比增长14%，广告业数智化转型加速推进。主流媒体广告业务平稳增长，积极发挥品牌传播重要作用，以电视台为代表的事业单位广告业务收入345.7亿元，同比增长3.3%。

headlines.title_en: In the first three quarters, revenue of leading advertising enterprises and institutions grew 8.5% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: According to the Shishuoxinyu WeChat account, data shows that in the first three quarters, leading enterprises and institutions engaged in advertising business nationwide achieved total revenue of 1.60083 trillion yuan, up 8.5% year-on-year. In the first three quarters, internet advertising revenue was 956.89 billion yuan, up 17.5% year-on-year, of which mobile internet advertising publishing revenue was 812.5 billion yuan, up 14% year-on-year, as the digital and intelligent transformation of the advertising industry accelerated. Advertising business of mainstream media grew steadily and continued to play an important role in brand communication, with advertising revenue of institutions such as TV stations at 34.57 billion yuan, up 3.3% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 国家外汇管理局：截至2026年10月末，我国外汇储备规模为34052亿美元
headlines.summary: 国家外汇管理局统计数据显示，截至2026年10月末，我国外汇储备规模为34052亿美元，较9月末上升49亿美元，升幅为0.14%。2026年10月，受全球宏观经济数据、主要经济体货币政策及预期等因素影响，美元指数上涨，全球主要金融资产价格涨跌互现。汇率折算和资产价格变化等因素综合作用，当月外汇储备规模上升。我国经济运行总体平稳，高质量发展取得新成效，为外汇储备规模保持基本稳定提供支撑。

headlines.title_en: SAFE: As of end-October 2026, China's foreign exchange reserves stood at US$3.4052 trillion
headlines.summary_en: Statistics from the State Administration of Foreign Exchange show that as of the end of October 2026, China's foreign exchange reserves stood at $3.4052 trillion, up $4.9 billion, or 0.14%, from the end of September. In October 2026, affected by factors such as global macroeconomic data and the monetary policies and expectations of major economies, the U.S. dollar index rose and prices of major global financial assets were mixed. Due to the combined effects of currency translation and changes in asset prices, the scale of foreign exchange reserves increased that month. China's economy has been operating generally steadily and has achieved new progress in high-quality development, providing support for keeping the scale of foreign exchange reserves basically stable.
